cover.subtitle: Structured cabling, fiber optic distribution and rack infrastructure — supplied as one connected range.

about.title: Who we are
about.body1: LOGX NETWORK is the connectivity brand of LOGX NETWORKS LTD, supplying the physical layer behind modern networks: copper and fiber cabling, patch panels, keystones, faceplates and rack accessories, engineered as one connected range rather than a shelf of unrelated parts.
about.body2: Across the Middle East, LOGX products are carried and supported by our regional distributor, Networks Sea Company, based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia — putting stock, pricing and technical support close to the project.

mission.title: Vision & mission
mission.vision: To be the dependable physical layer behind every network we touch — infrastructure that installers trust and that disappears into the work.
mission.mission: To supply a single, connected range of copper, fiber and rack products, specified around repeatable installation, tested performance and clear documentation, so every project ships with confidence.

why.title: Why LOGX
why.point1: Every product is specified around repeatable installation, dependable materials and the realities of the network room.
why.point2: Copper, fiber, patching and rack accessories are designed to work together across enterprise and data center environments.
why.point3: Copper cable ships Fluke channel tested, and every product family carries a technical datasheet with standards, characteristics and ordering information.

compliance.title: Standards & compliance
compliance.intro: LOGX products are specified against the standards installers already design to.
compliance.item4: CE and UL 94V-0 fire-safety rated components

range.title: Product range
range.copperBody: CAT6 and CAT6A UTP cable, patch cords and bulk reels, Fluke channel tested.
range.fiberBody: Single-mode and OM3 drop cable, patch cords, pigtails, splice and distribution panels.
range.accessoriesBody: Patch panels, keystones, faceplates, cable managers, RJ45 plugs and PDUs.
